next.reason: 1985: 'If the AT END phrase is not specified, a USE AFTER STANDARD EXCEPTION procedure must be associated with this file-name-1'; 2023: 'If there are no applicable at end exception processing statements, control is transferred to the end of the READ statement.'. Same at end flow, but 2023 drops the requirement for a USE procedure when AT END is absent: control just goes to the end of the READ. It also adds the EC-I-O-AT-END setting.
